source.description: Suetonius wrote his Lives of the Twelve Caesarsin the reign of Vespasian around A.D. 70. He conicled the extraordinary careers of Julius, Augustus, Tiberius, Caligula, Claudius, Nero, Vespasian and Domitian and the rest in technicolour terms.
